snippet.title: Terminal War - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A brand new gamplay reveal trailer for Terminal War. Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
